text:
jordan: Quick planning thread for the post-launch newsletter + drip. goal: 4-touch mini course -> invite to benchmark webinar -> CTA to try dedicated. keep copy terse.

liam: agree. propose segments: eng_clickers (clicked demo/code), curious_readers (subscribed only), enterprise_ops (company emails + >50 employees).

rachel: mapping exists in Growth DB but needs a tag cleanup. i'll run a sweep to remove duplicates.

jordan: cadence thought: M1 (welcome + value bullets, day 0), M2 (short benchmark highlights + metric screenshot, day 2), M3 (customer note + 3-min demo link, day 6), M4 (webinar invite + calendar link, day 12).

nina: subject lines: M1: "You're in — what to expect from Redwood" vs "Welcome aboard — quick tour". test only on eng_clickers first.

liam: creative note: M2 should include a tiny chart image (png) showing latency/cost delta. keep file <120KB.

rachel: tracking tokens: opens, clicks, chart_clicks, demo_clicks, webinar_regs. use utm_campaign=launch_nurture_q4 and utm_content={segment}.

jordan: for eng_clickers include an inline curl snippet: ```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/completions -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha","prompt":"test"}'
``` put that in M3 only.

nina: send windows: eng_clickers Tue/Thu 9am PT, curious_readers Wed 2pm PT, enterprise_ops Mon 11am PT.

liam: rollout: stage A = eng_clickers (n = 4k) next Tue -> hold 24h -> check open >= 15% or swap subject. then expand.

rachel: i'll export segment CSV to #marketing-assets with columns: email,segment,company_size,intent_flag,signup_ts. ETA tomorrow 9am.

jordan: owners: rachel = segment exports + suppressions, nina = subject + creative, liam = deployment (Braze), me = copy + final review.

marketing-bot: reminder set: draft copy due Fri EOD, creative assets due Mon. :bell:

nina: small ask 12 if company_size > 50 surface enterprise scheduling link `https://cal.redwood.ai/enterprise` with utm_medium=email.

liam: add guardrails: suppress anyone who cold-unsubscribed in last 90 days and exclude internal domains.

rachel: noted. i'll attach the suppression list when I drop the CSV.

jordan: measurement: create funnel `launch_nurture_q4_eng` and monitor rate to trial_start within 14 days.

liam: one more: include a plain-text fallback in all emails for deliverability.

nina: i'll produce 3 subject variants per message and we can A/B in Braze.

jordan: ok team — next check-in here after first send. thanks! :sparkles:
